title: OpenAI features Anima's work with care teams
summary: OpenAI's customer story explores how Anima uses AI to gather patient histories, process clinical documents and prepare notes for clinician review.
body_markdown:
Shun Pang and Michael Skupien explain how Anima brings patient calls, clinical documents and consultation notes together, giving care teams more time to respond to patients.


[Read the full story on OpenAI](https://openai.com/index/anima/)
